name: 33174 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33174 (Miami) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33174 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
